name: The Ancient Egg
summary: Yeh'kinya in Tanaris tells of an ancient egg named in the Prophecy of Mosh'aru, left from the age when trolls held vast empires. It can contain Hakkar's essence, and Yeh'kinya wants it fetched from Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A Relic of Troll Empires
sections.body: An ancient egg is spoken of in the Prophecy of Mosh'aru, a relic of the age when trolls held vast empires. Its power can contain Hakkar's essence, and Yeh'kinya believes it could be the sole means of guarding the world from his evil.

sections.title: Behind the Amphitheater
sections.body: Yeh'kinya asks you to bring the egg to Tanaris. Tales say it lies concealed far inside Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, within a cave behind the amphitheater atop the city. Yeh'kinya senses great forces stirring and fears that time is running short.

faq.answer: It is a relic from the age when trolls held vast empires, spoken of in the Prophecy of Mosh'aru. Its power can contain Hakkar's essence.

faq.q: Why does Yeh'kinya want the egg?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya believes the egg could be the sole means of guarding the world from Hakkar's evil.
Tales place it deep inside Jintha'Alor, in a cave behind the amphitheater that crowns the city.

faq.q: Who wants the egg brought to them?
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya, who waits in Tanaris, wants the ancient egg brought there.
